sourceMethod: Independent web rendering of direct official Qavanin text, metadata and status-index pages. The rendering exposed document text and line-addressable page content, but raw HTTP response bytes were not captured and no source SHA-256 was computed.

consolidatedLaw.title: قانون صدور چک
consolidatedLaw.note: The consolidated page currently renders Article 7 with an amendment label dated 1403/03/30 and the listed monetary thresholds. The original law's Gazette and effective dates belong only to the 1355 enactment; they do not prove the publication, commencement or temporal application of the 1403 adjustment. The current consolidated rendering is not an approved event-date version.

influencingInstrument.title: اصلاح ميزان مبالغ مربوط به جرائم و تخلفات مندرج در قوانين مختلف

officialStatusIndex.dateMeaning: The 1403/03/30 date is the approval date displayed in the official status index; it is not, by itself, a Gazette publication date or commencement date.

limitations: The official portal's current consolidated text is readable, but raw response bytes and a reproducible SHA-256 were not captured.
The 1403 instrument's direct text and metadata endpoints timed out in this observation; the status index shows only its approval date.
The 1403 Gazette issue, publication date, commencement date, subsequent adjustments and transitional/temporal application remain unverified in this run.
The 1400 amendment text and metadata remain research observations only because raw bytes and text-bound human review are absent.
No non-overlapping event-date version has been approved, and no qualified human legal review is recorded.
